utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hi there. Can you hear me okay?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Loud and clear, Hal! It's Remi. I have a question from your grandson Sam today. He asked: what was your first car?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Oh, Sam asked that? Ha. Well, um, that'd be the Bel Air. A fifty-seven Chevy Bel Air. Two-tone, turquoise and white. I bought it in, uh, sixty-two, I think, from a fella down on Union Avenue. Paid three hundred dollars for it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: A 1957 Bel Air for three hundred dollars! How did you save up for it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: I was working at the shops by then, you know, the railroad shops. Saved up, um, most of a summer. My dad thought I was crazy. He said, uh, you don't need a car, you got two feet and a bus. But I wanted it bad.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can imagine. What do you remember most about driving it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: The, uh, the sound of it. That V8. And the fins, I mean, those fins were something. I took Dorothy to the drive-in in that car. And, um, it had this thing with the radiator, it would boil over going up the hill on the way to Altoona, so I kept a jug of water in the trunk. Every time. You learn to fix stuff yourself when you got no money.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's a great memory. There's actually a photo here of you with a car in 1962. Is that the Bel Air?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: That's it! Oh my. Look at that. I had more hair then. I washed that car every Saturday, whether it needed it or not.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Sam will love hearing this. What happened to the Bel Air in the end?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Sold it, um, when Linda was born. Needed something with, you know, more room and a heater that worked. Got a Ford wagon. Never loved that wagon the same way. I mean, I wish I'd kept the Chevy. They're worth a fortune now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll make sure Sam gets the story. Thanks so much, Hal. Talk again soon?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: You bet. Tell Sam to call his grandpa. Bye now.
